prompt: a 60mm square aluminium plate 5mm thick with a 6mm hole in the middle
why: The floor. One part, one hole, no assembly. Two paid runs failed on it, $0.82, and both taught something. The architect DID answer with one node and zero repairs, so C1 works. But it declared a BORE and a FLAT_FACE at the same origin, which no geometry satisfies: run one spent 5 calls and landed error_contract, correctly attributed; run two spent 4 and bridged the bore with a 0.35mm web to satisfy the face, reporting a hole that does not pass through. cadFaceHoleConflictLint now catches that at plan time. This case also over-specified: it demanded the type name CLEARANCE_HOLE when the prompt pins a 6mm hole through a plate, and BORE is a fair name for it. Assert the measurable fact.
